text: Security Engineer at HealthGuard Solutions, focused on safeguarding healthcare data and systems. Over the past year, I’ve led initiatives to strengthen access controls, reducing unauthorized access risks by 40% through IAM overhauls. Regular security audits have helped identify and mitigate vulnerabilities in critical patient data workflows. Own encryption frameworks that protect data at rest and in transit, with measurable impact on compliance and breach prevention. Designed network security protocols that align with HIPAA standards, ensuring seamless yet secure data flow across healthtech platforms. Penetration testing efforts have uncovered critical gaps, enabling proactive fixes before exploits. SIEM integration improved threat detection response times by 30%, enhancing real-time monitoring. Application security is central to my work—architected systems to meet OWASP guidelines, mentoring teams on secure coding practices. Balancing technical rigor with business needs, I prioritize solutions that protect patient trust without hindering care delivery. Always learning, always adapting—because security in healthtech isn’t just a role, it’s a responsibility.
